description: This source file implements a command-line interface (CLI) for the agent software. It includes functions for parsing CLI arguments, handling different commands like 'help', 'list', and version, formatting output, and managing the CLI context within the agent's operation. The code also defines related data structures such as CLI errors, CLI invocation details, and context keys. It interacts with agent reasoners, supports output in JSON, YAML, and pretty (indented JSON) formats, and implements a help system for usage guidance.

classes.name: CLIError
classes.description: Represents errors encountered during CLI processing, with a code indicating the error type and an underlying error.

classes.name: cliInvocation
classes.description: Struct holding parsed CLI invocation parameters such as command, output format, input data, flags, and help flags.

classes.name: cliContext
classes.description: Stores CLI-related context information for a particular invocation, including arguments, command, output format, and color usage.

methods.name: IsCLIMode
methods.description: Checks if the current context is running in CLI mode.

methods.name: GetCLIArgs
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed CLI arguments from the given context.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Executes the CLI logic based on the provided arguments and context, handling commands and output formatting.

methods.name: parseCLIArgs
methods.description: Parses CLI command-line arguments into a structured invocation object, handling flags, input, output, and commands.

methods.name: buildCLIArgMap
methods.description: Constructs a map of argument keys to values for use in the agent's context based on the invocation.

methods.name: isSupportedOutput
methods.description: Checks if a given output format string is supported.

methods.name: applySet
methods.description: Processes a key=value string and inserts into a target map.

methods.name: parseJSONFromStdin
methods.description: Reads JSON data from stdin if available and parses it.

methods.name: parseJSONFromFile
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON data from a specified file.

methods.name: decodeJSONInput
methods.description: Decodes a raw JSON string into a map.

methods.name: mergeInput
methods.description: Merges multiple JSON input sources and CLI flags into a single map.

methods.name: parseScalar
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string as JSON scalar; defaults to string.

methods.name: defaultFormatter
methods.description: Returns a function that formats and outputs the result based on the format and color preferences.

methods.name: printList
methods.description: Displays a list of available reasoners with optional marking of defaults.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Prints usage, commands, flags, and help information for the CLI.

methods.name: printVersion
methods.description: Outputs version information for the agent and the Go runtime.

methods.name: withCLIContext
methods.description: Associates a CLI context with a general context, enabling CLI state passing.

methods.name: hasCLIReasoners
methods.description: Checks if there are any reasoners enabled for CLI use within the agent.
